review_description: The whole process from quotation to final installation was seamless.When dealing with Euan you don’t feel like you are being sold something, rather that he is providing a solution to for your needs.  We had no real idea of what size of system we needed and left that to Euan.  Time has proven his recommendation to be the right one.Euan supplies the best quality products (LG Panels & Fronius inverter) and his installation team are top notch tradespeople that do a beautiful job.Highly recommended company and I would use them again without a second thought.

Installed LG Neon panels with a Fronius inverter system on a split roof layout with DC optimisers.Really nice knowledgeable people to deal with. Excellent workmanship and took care of everything including the grid connection for us.

Essential Solar came in as a close second.In the end I went with the other supplier as they made a greater effort to optimise the positioning and distribution of the panels on my roof based on exact roof orientation and potential shading.
